description:
Eddie Ruan Senior Staff Engineer / Director Network System Software - Alibaba
Dennis Cai TBD - Alibaba

At OCP 2025, Microsoft introduced the Fairwater AI data center for large-scale AI clusters. By enabling SRv6 at the host, they limited the routing scale to under 1,000 routes with 256 ECMP paths. However, other cloud providers cannot easily mandate such host-side changes for diverse customers.

In this talk, we want to present a new way to decouple service route distribution and infrastructure route distribution architecturally. For infrastructure routes, we still use regular BGP to distribute them within spine and leaf. For service routes, we use multiple RRs to redistribute them among leaf switches. These service routes are recursive over the loopback address of the leaf switch they are anchored to. Since we dont want service routes to be impacted by RR cluster outages, we introduce a Group RR concept， where multiple RRs operate as a coordinated group to enhance Graceful Restart capability and ensure high availability for critical service prefixes.
fulltitle: Beyond Traditional BGP Decoupling Route Distribution for Large Scale AI Clusters at Alibaba
